meta.title: SAMPLE asset register — NOT ACSA DATA
meta.why: A stand-in so the asset-link fields can be built and tested before ACSA supplies the real register. Every assetId begins with SAMPLE- so a stand-in tag cannot be mistaken for a real one anywhere it appears, and meta.source is what the app reads to decide whether these may leave the device.
meta.replaceWith: Overwrite this file with the real register in the same shape and set meta.source to "acsa". Nothing else in the app needs to change.
